items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: She always used to call me Ozy Ole. I said 'how you doing, Billie.' ... I just loved Billie, she was a wonderful girl, boy.

ctx.x: I guess her reputation followed her around after that time.
Too bad. Yeah, Billie Holiday, Lady Day. Yeah, she, beautiful. She used call me Ozy. Well see, on the drums it was 'Cozy.' A C and then a O Z Y. O L E. She

always used to call me Ozy Ole. I said 'how you doing, Billie.' And she used to come in and sit around. I just loved Billie, she was a wonderful girl, boy. Too bad. It was her mind and that's the way her mind ruled her.
